items.title: Coherent (COHR) Authorizes A $2.0b Buyback, Is The 47% Undervaluation Case Intact?
items.summary: Coherent (COHR) has drawn fresh attention after authorizing a share repurchase program of up to US$2.0b with no expiration date, a capital return move that gives investors a new variable to track. Recent trading has been choppy. Coherent’s share price has fallen 9.1% over the past day and is down 33.3% over 90 days. However, the 1 year total shareholder return of 31.8% and 3 year total shareholder return above 4x show that longer term momentum is still intact. Spot other AI infrastructure...
